verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a Git hosting platform like GitLab, but the evidence pack never documents push or pull repository mirroring to or from another Git server. The GitHub importer is a one-off migration rather than ongoing mirroring. The Unito and GitBook entries are third-party sync integrations, not GitLab's own repo mirroring, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can mirror repositories or branches to and from another Git server
